public_research.plain_statement: On N points and N lines with no two points on two common lines, every AND/OR circuit of fan-in at most two and output line-degree at most 3 that is true only at inputs where some point and a line through it are on is true at the input with exactly p and l on for at most 888 times its size plus 9N plus 444 incident pairs (p, l). No hypotheses. Conjecture, on paper: the checked conditional form applied to four checked statements.

prerequisites.title: Line-degree-3 bound for a circuit only below the incidence function, given four lemmas: accepted incident pairs at most 888 size + 9 N + 444
Diagonal lemma at line-degree 3: pairs that every firing product needs its own line for number at most 100 (size + J) + 4N

public_research.title: Line-degree 3, unconditional, below the incidence function: a circuit true only at incident inputs accepts at most 888 size + 9N + 444 incident pairs

statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (I : Fin N → Fin N → Prop) [DecidableRel I] (Ckt : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), (∀ p p' l l' : Fin N, p ≠ p' → l ≠ l' → ¬ (I p l ∧ I p l' ∧ I p' l ∧ I p' l')) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 Ckt → PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.HasLineDegree (N + N) (Finset.Ico N (N + N)) Ckt 3 → (∀ z : Fin (N + N) → Bool, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (N + N) Ckt z = true → ∃ p l : Fin N, I p l ∧ z (Fin.castAdd N p) = true ∧ z (Fin.natAdd N l) = true) → (Finset.univ.filter (fun e : Fin N × Fin N => I e.1 e.2 ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (N + N) Ckt (fun k => decide (k = Fin.castAdd N e.1 ∨ k = Fin.natAdd N e.2)) = true)).card ≤ 888 * Ckt.size + 9 * N + 444
